verdict.rationale: Bitbucket Pipelines offers deployment environments with centralized visibility and environment-level permissions. Change approval and mapping incidents to deployments are claimed, but they are tied to Jira Service Management. All evidence is high-level marketing copy, with no detail on how gates are configured or how a change is tracked per environment. Missing for 10: documented approval gates native to Bitbucket environments, explicit per-environment deployment history showing which commit is deployed where, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
